meta.title: Da Nang VIETNAM ● Street Food Tour in Son Tra Night Market, Da Nang 【🇻🇳 4K】
meta.description:
In today's Vietnam 4K Tour, we will explore Son Tra Night market in Da Nang city, Vietnam.

Time: 6:30 PM
Date: May 2024
Temperature: 30 Degrees Celsius
Location: Son Tra Night market, Da Nang Vietnam

Camera used in this video - https://amzn.to/3U0FpOt
Microphone used in this video - https://amzn.to/2KMs1cs

What was your favorite part of this video? Let me know in the comments. 

Subscribe for more ASMR 4k virtual walking tour & cycling tour videos in Vietnam!

And don't miss the 40-meter-high Sky Bar, where you can sip your favorite drink while enjoying breathtaking views of Da Nang's coastline, city lights and night skyline. 
Best of all: FREE ENTRY!
📍 140 Vo Nguyen Giap, Son Tra, Da Nang
 Save this spot for your next night out in Da Nang!
